about_short_description.short_description: Pando Bioscience is a drug discovery platform based on synthetic biology.

product.name: GenAI-Powered Protein Engineering
product.description: A platform that designs proteins with specific desired properties using generative AI, evolutionary analysis, and enzyme domain knowledge.

product.name: GenAI-Powered Pathway Engineering
product.description: A service that designs protein binders and scaffolds to enhance biochemical pathways and improve production titers beyond conventional methods.

product.name: High Throughput Protein-Protein Interaction Screening
product.description: A platform for identifying, mapping, screening, and analyzing protein-protein interactions and pathways efficiently and cost-effectively.
